chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Abu 'Ubaydah al-Hadda' said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'A woman is not married off while her paternal aunt is married to the same man, nor her maternal aunt, nor her milk-sister.'

The meaning in this report is like the meaning in what preceded regarding the paternal and maternal aunt from the side of lineage, for that is not permissible with the removal of their mutual marriage (to the same man).
As for with the obtaining of permission from both of them, there is no harm with it, according to what we have previously established regarding the ruling of lineage.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a woman while her aunt or milk-sister is already married to the same man?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Abu Abdullah (Imam al-Sadiq) to clarify that the prohibition of a woman marrying the paternal aunt, maternal aunt, or milk-sister of another woman is rooted in kinship (nasab) and fosterage (radha'ah). The text explicitly notes that while the default ruling is prohibition, it can be lifted with the permission of the women involved, mirroring the flexibility found in other marital restrictions within Shia jurisprudence.
